name: Agent TARS / UI-TARS Desktop
description: ByteDance's multimodal agent stack: the Agent TARS CLI and web UI, and a desktop app that controls your computer with UI-TARS models.
whatItDoes: Agent TARS performs browser and tool-based tasks such as booking or research from a terminal or web UI; UI-TARS Desktop lets a vision-language model operate the local or a remote computer and browser from natural-language instructions.
howItWorks: Agent TARS runs a multimodal agent loop combining visual GUI grounding, DOM-based browser control and MCP tools. The desktop app is an Electron application that sends screenshots to a UI-TARS or other vision model and executes the returned actions.

requirements.name: Model API key
requirements.description: Passed with --apiKey for Volcengine, Anthropic or another provider

models: UI-TARS, Doubao (Volcengine), Anthropic and other vision models
